description: A lazy push-based stream that can emit zero or more values and then complete or error.
The `{ next, error, complete }` object (or a single `next` function) passed to `subscribe()`.
Returned by `subscribe()`. `unsubscribe()` stops delivery and runs the teardown.
Function returned from the producer of `new Observable`; cleans up timers, listeners or requests.
Each subscriber triggers its own execution of the producer (HTTP, `interval`).
Convert an observable into a Promise of its first or last value.
